up: Retrieve compounds with exact IC50 activity values (in nM) against human 5-lipoxygenase. Output columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, assay_description, pubmed_id_or_doi. Filter criteria: 1) Target: Human 5-lipoxygenase (filter assays by organism='Homo sapiens' and target name containing '5-lipoxygenase'). 2) Activity type: IC50. 3) Units: nM. 4) Exact values: standard_relation = '='. 5) Reference: Include PubMed ID or DOI from the associated document. Return distinct rows for each compound-activity pair.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.pref_name LIKE '%5-lipoxygenase%'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
